description: Count the words, characters, sentences and paragraphs in a text, and estimate how many pages it fills at a given font, font size and line spacing. Inputs: text, and optional font (times new roman, arial, calibri, georgia, courier new or verdana, default times new roman), font_size in points (default 12) and spacing (single, 1.5 or double, default double).     The page count is an estimate from typical words per page, so a word processor may differ by a little. Also returns an estimated reading time at 238 words per minute. Example: "Count the words in this essay and estimate the pages in Times New Roman 12 double spaced.

font.description: Font name. Default times new roman.

name: count_text
title: Count words, sentences and pages
